db2da217b8dc39a3.description: Position summary The Senior Electrical Engineer owns the electrical design review, power system studies and protection coordination for the department's capital projects, from concept through commissioning and handover to Operations. Job title: Senior Electrical Engineer Department: Project & Design Reports to: Manager, Project & Design Department Location: Saudi Arabia (project and mine sites, including Al Jalamid / Wa'ad Al Shamal) Employment: Full-time, site travel required Interfaces: Operations, Maintenance, HSE, Procurement, EPC contractors, consultants, utility (SEC) Key responsibilities Review and approve electrical design deliverables from consultants and EPC contractors: single-line diagrams, load lists, cable schedules, layouts, earthing and lightning protection. Perform and verify power system studies in ETAP: load flow, short circuit, arc flash, motor starting, protection coordination and harmonics. Own protection philosophy and relay settings; review coordination studies and witness relay testing. Specify HV/MV/LV equipment: power transformers, switchgear, MCCs, VFDs, UPS, cables and substations. Lead technical bid evaluation for electrical packages and support Procurement on scope and specifications. Coordinate technical interfaces with utilities and authorities (e.g. SEC) where a project requires grid connection or approvals. Attend FAT/SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning; sign off punch lists and handover dossiers. Ensure compliance with Ma'aden standards, IEC, IEEE, NFPA 70E and SEC/SBC requirements. Review contractor technical queries, deviations and change requests, with cost and schedule impact. Support Operations with troubleshooting, failure investigations and reliability improvements. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the department's design standards. Plant equipment knowledge The candidate must have hands-on, technical command of every major electrical asset in an operating mining and processing plant, not only design or study experience. Other tools: AutoCAD Electrical, DIgSILENT or SKM (plus); experience with utility connections and approvals (SEC or similar). Industry: Mining, minerals processing, oil and gas or heavy industry. Equipment knowledge requirements Power transformers: OLTC operation, ONAN/ONAF cooling, Buchholz, oil and winding temperature protection, DGA and oil test interpretation, inrush behaviour. HV/MV switchgear: GIS and AIS, vacuum circuit breakers, vacuum contactors (F-C), interlocking, CT/VT sizing and saturation effect on protection. Transformer and bus protection: Differential, REF, bus differential, breaker failure, inrush and over-excitation blocking. Motor protection: Thermal model, locked rotor, stall, unbalance, earth fault, starts per hour, RTD inputs. Feeder protection: Overcurrent and earth fault grading, directional elements, auto-reclose where applicable. Large MV motors: Crusher, conveyor, mill and slurry pump drives; DOL, soft starter and VFD starting; IR/PI testing; voltage dip on starting; electrical causes of bearing and vibration faults. Variable frequency drives (MV/LV): Drive topologies, harmonics and filters, bearing currents, motor cable length and dv/dt, cooling and derating in heat and dust. Generators (gas turbine, diesel): AVR and excitation, governor, synchronizing, load sharing, generator protection, black start. Qualifications and experience BSc in Electrical Engineering (Power) from an accredited university; MSc is a plus. 10+ years in power systems, combining both sides: at least 3 years hands-on in an operating heavy-industry plant (maintenance, troubleshooting or commissioning) and at least 5 years in design review or owner's engineer roles on capital projects. Proven track record of ETAP studies and relay coordination on HV/MV networks, and of hands-on relay testing and commissioning (portfolio of studies and test reports requested at interview). Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration, Professional Engineer level. Preferred certifications: PE, NFPA 70E, vendor relay training (SEL/ABB/Siemens), PMP. Fluent English, written and spoken; Arabic is a plus. Valid Saudi driving licence; willing to travel to remote sites. Additional equipment knowledge requirements DC systems and UPS: 110 VDC tripping batteries and chargers, battery sizing and testing, earth fault on DC systems, UPS for control and instrumentation. LV distribution: MCCs, ACBs, MCCBs, selectivity between devices, intelligent MCC communication. MV/LV cables: Sizing and derating, MV terminations and joints, VLF, tan delta and partial discharge testing, fault location. Power factor correction: Capacitor banks, detuned reactors, resonance with VFD harmonics. Earthing and lightning: Earthing design and testing in high-resistivity desert soil, step and touch voltage, lightning protection. Control and monitoring: Interface with PLC/DCS, power management system (PMS), load shedding schemes, IEC 61850 substation automation. Substation buildings: HVAC for switchrooms, dust ingress, IP ratings, fire detection and suppression. Hazardous areas: Area classification and Ex equipment (IECEx/ATEX) for fuel storage and other classified areas. Soft skills The candidate must challenge contractors with confidence and explain technical risk to non-electrical managers. Strong technical judgement and ownership of decisions Clear written comments on contractor submittals Works well across Operations, Maintenance and Procurement Calm under shutdown and commissioning pressure Desired Candidate Profile -

db2ecff3a8de55d4.description: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Riyadh — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless. This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale. You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall. The Pod Model Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload. We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu. What You'll Do Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Jais, ALLaM, or other Arabic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't Design model routing strategies for real-time voice db23b972ff050cee.description: About Foodics Foodics is a leading provider of restaurant management ecosystems and payment technology. Established in 2014, Foodics is headquartered in Riyadh with offices in five countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan, and Kuwait. The company serves customers and partners in over 35 countries globally, having processed over 6 billion orders. Foodics has secured three funding rounds, with the latest raising $170 million, making it one of the rapidly evolving SaaS companies in the MENA region. Role Overview: AI Engineer Foodics is seeking an AI Engineer to construct agentic AI architecture. This full-time role involves leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on hands-on backend software engineering, including coding, testing, and system diagnostics within a compact engineering team. While prompt design is part of the workflow, the primary focus is on addressing complex architectural challenges within the underlying infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers with precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions, adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. Required Experience and Skills 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in backend software engineering, including coding, testing, and system diagnostics. Experience with microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and evaluation harnesses. Ability to build production-ready, reliable, and scalable systems. Understanding of agentic engineering principles and large language models. Work Environment and Culture Foodics fosters an inclusive and diverse culture that supports innovation and offers flexible in-office and hybrid work setups. The company provides competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and potential for shares. Foodics prioritizes personal development through regular training and an annual learning stipend. The team comprises over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, offering opportunities for autonomy, mentorship, and challenging goals. Career Development Foodics welcomes applicants across diverse seniority levels, acknowledging that production-grade agentic engineering is an emerging discipline. Candidate capability will determine final level placement, with opportunities ranging from early-career developers to veteran software architects. Engineering excellence is mandatory at all levels; junior engineers will be paired with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers will drive technical standards and architectural vision.

db8392de17e6b703.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking an HSSE Section Head to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) management within construction projects. Role Overview The HSSE Section Head will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the robust implementation of HSSE provisions across projects. This involves coordinating with various stakeholders, conducting audits, and providing expert advice to maintain compliance with all relevant regulations and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Ensure the availability and adequacy of all Supervision Consultant's (Engineer's) and Contractors' HSE provisions in accordance with policy, contract conditions, HSE plans, Employer's HSE Requirements, and applicable local, national, and international regulations. Measure the HSE performance of the Supervision Consultant (Engineer) and Contractors, and advise on necessary actions for improvement. Investigate direct and root causes of accidents/incidents, and recommend preventative measures. Record and follow up on identified safety hazards and non-conformances with HSE regulators and relevant authorities. Coordinate with the PMC Project Manager/Construction Manager to implement effective HSE systems on project sites. Liaise with the Employer, PMC (Hill International), and Local/Enforcing Authorities/Municipality Authorities to ensure adherence to Project HSE Requirements. Provide training and induction for staff on HSE protocols. Review and approve Contractors' HSE documents, submittals, and drawings to verify suitability, adequacy, and conformance. Ensure full compliance of the Supervision Consultant (Engineer) and Contractors with Project HSE Requirements. Conduct scheduled and unscheduled HSE audits and inspections, reporting non-conformances to the Project management team for corrective action. Maintain awareness of relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures within Hill International, ensuring continuous compliance. Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in HSSE roles, preferably within the construction industry. Demonstrated knowledge of local, national, and international HSE statutes and regulations. Proven ability to conduct HSE audits, investigations, and implement corrective actions. dbf254b90cc6f1ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرحاب للعطور عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الاتجاهات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء وتحديد مجالات التحسين. القدرة على وضع الخطط البيعية وتحويل الأهداف إلى إجراءات عملية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات في بيئة ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق مبيعات شركة الرحاب للعطور، ويكون مسؤولاً عن تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة الرحاب للعطور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

dbfa27288e824a00.description: About the Role Mayar Foods is seeking a Storekeeper to manage inventory, maintain store operations, and supervise activities within its facilities. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia and requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Storekeeper is responsible for overseeing all material movements to and from warehouses, ensuring efficient and safe handling to minimize damage. The role involves regular inspections and managing daily collections from sales representatives, contributing to the smooth operation of the supply chain. Key Responsibilities Prepare the store for incoming stock, adhering to standard operating procedures for space management. Supervise loaders and laborers, coordinating with logistics for the dispatch of customer orders. Ensure the hygiene of trucks and proper loading of goods, including visual inspection for potential issues like leakage, especially during monsoon seasons. Oversee the off-loading of stock, reviewing goods for damages or shortages, and reporting any issues to the Warehouse Manager or Logistics Supervisor. Receive damaged and returned goods, assess their condition, and obtain necessary approvals before acceptance. Identify and report unsafe conditions or work practices within the store environment. Ensure safe and timely loading and unloading operations, verifying goods against a checklist. Conduct periodic physical stock counts, complete counting sheets, reconcile variances in SKUs, and update records accordingly. Verify and maintain appropriate stock arrangement within the store. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a storekeeping or related role. Ability to manage inventory and supervise store activities effectively. Familiarity with material handling procedures and safety protocols. Work Type This is a full-time position within Mayar Foods, offering an opportunity to contribute to a key operational function. Location The role is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia.

dba2b3a7e1a539b6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع السلامه الطبي عن أخصائي جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في خميس مشيط، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطبيق معايير الجودة، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتطوير أنظمة تدقيق الجودة لضمان تقديم خدمات عالية المستوى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وإعداد وتصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة، وتحديد وتطوير مواصفات ومعايير ومؤشرات لمختلف العمليات والمخرجات. المساهمة الفعالة في تطوير معايير ومواصفات الجودة المطلوبة للمبادرات والبرامج والمخرجات قيد التطوير وفقاً لخطط العمل. إعداد وتطوير استبيانات قياس مستوى رضا العملاء عن جودة الخدمات والعمليات والإجراءات، وتوثيق وتحليل توصياتهم التحسينية. تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات ونماذج تدقيق الجودة، والمشاركة في وضع خطط التدقيق الدوري والسنوي، وتنفيذ عمليات ضبط وتدقيق الجودة بشكل متكامل ودقيق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالجودة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الجودة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تصميم وتطبيق أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة. فهم عميق لمعايير ومواصفات الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم رضا العملاء وتطوير الأنظمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع السلامه الطبي بمدينة خميس مشيط، عسير. يتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في الخدمات المقدمة. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

dbb9aa2beb953136.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الامداد المتمكن المحدودة عن مسوق إلكتروني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق الرقمي، ويقدم فرصة للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. يركز الدور على تطوير وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية من الفكرة الأولية وحتى تحقيق النتائج الملموسة، مع التركيز على تحويل الظهور الإعلاني إلى تفاعل حقيقي وفعال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إنشاء وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي المختلفة. تطوير الاستراتيجيات والأفكار الإعلانية المبتكرة والمناسبة لكل حملة. متابعة أداء الحملات الإعلانية بشكل مستمر وتحليل النتائج لتحسينها. إعداد المحتوى الإعلاني وصياغة الأفكار والرسائل التسويقية الجذابة. تصميم محتوى مرئي جذاب ومناسب للحملات على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. ابتكار أفكار إبداعية للمحتوى والإعلانات لزيادة التفاعل. متابعة أحدث التوجهات (الترندات) وتوظيفها لخدمة العلامة التجارية. العمل على تطوير الحضور الرقمي للشركة وزيادة التفاعل والوصول إلى الجمهور المستهدف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في التسويق الإلكتروني وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية. القدرة على تحليل الأرقام وقراءة نتائج الحملات الإعلانية بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بتصميم محتوى وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. الجمع بين الإبداع التسويقي والقدرة على التنفيذ العملي. الطموح والرغبة في المساهمة في نمو الشركة. المهارات الشخصية التفكير الإبداعي وتقديم أفكار غير تقليدية في التسويق. القدرة على تحويل الأفكار الإعلانية إلى نتائج حقيقية وملموسة. فهم عميق لكيفية تحويل الإعلان من مجرد ظهور إلى تفاعل فعال. بيئة العمل العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق نمو مستمر للشركة من خلال استراتيجيات تسويقية مبتكرة وفعالة. تفاصيل إضافية يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. إذا كنت ترى أن التسويق يتجاوز مجرد الإعلان ويشمل الفكرة المقنعة والتصميم الجذاب والحملة التي تحقق النتائج، فإننا ندعوك لتقديم إبداعك.

dbd18c6802089293.description: About the Role SME Careers is seeking a Malayalam Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) for a remote, contract position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Malayalam AI training projects. The QAL will review AI-generated Malayalam content and work from trainers and QAs, ensuring adherence to project guidelines and quality standards. This position is crucial for improving AI models by ensuring Malayalam training data is accurate, culturally appropriate, and aligned with client expectations. Key Responsibilities Conduct spot-checks of Malayalam items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback, and escalate critical concerns. Communicate updates to trainers and QAs regarding new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. Respond promptly and clearly to trainer/QA questions, particularly concerning Malayalam wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and regional usage. Manage trainer/QA activation by contacting inactive contributors, encouraging participation, tracking follow-ups, and flagging availability issues. Create and maintain Malayalam project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, and onboarding materials. Schedule and conduct onboarding/training calls for trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, and Malayalam-specific style requirements. Ensure consistent application of Malayalam language guidelines by all trainers and QAs, and communicate project updates effectively. Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and contribute to building scalable QA processes for Malayalam-language projects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Malayalam, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a related field. Native or near-native Malayalam proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. Strong grasp of the English language for following guidelines, team communication, and providing feedback. 3+ years of professional experience in Malayalam writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or similar language review workflows. Strong understanding of Malayalam grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. Ability to evaluate Malayalam content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, or inconsistent terminology. Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is preferred. Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong advantage. Required Skills Excellent attention to detail and structured communication abilities. Proficiency in managing quality workflows across remote teams. Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and project management systems. Highly organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, and other quality documentation. Work Environment This is an hourly, remote contractor role with SME Careers, a subsidiary of SuperAnnotate. The position involves working with remote teams to deliver training data for AI companies and foundation-model labs. Application Process The selection process for this role includes an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter.

Accor offers opportunities for professional development and advancement within its network. This full-time role serves as the initial point of contact for guests, focusing on creating a welcoming atmosphere and ensuring smooth dining experiences. The position requires strong organizational skills, a commitment to guest service, and adherence to brand standards, contributing directly to the restaurant's operational success. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests with professionalism, setting a positive tone for their dining experience. Manage guest seating, table allocations, and dining flow efficiently based on reservations and walk-ins. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of menus, special events, seating arrangements, and guest preferences. Answer phone calls professionally, assisting guests with inquiries, bookings, and special requests. db38fc3d02d5e6b5.description: About the Role Tristar Group is seeking a Divisional Operations Manager – Road Transport to be based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading and overseeing road transport operations across assigned locations, ensuring efficiency and compliance with business objectives. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage road transport operations to ensure they are safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective. This includes optimizing fleet and manpower utilization, coordinating maintenance, controlling fuel and tyre costs, fostering a strong safety culture, ensuring customer satisfaction, and promoting continuous improvement. The manager will also embed safety and environmental aspects of sustainability into daily operations and business strategy. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily fleet utilization and availability, coordinating with maintenance to minimize downtime and control unnecessary running. Manage driver availability, scheduling, and utilization to meet customer requirements and minimize idle time. Oversee fuel consumption, implement actions to improve mileage, investigate abnormalities, and identify cost reduction opportunities. Monitor tyre utilization, replacement, and performance, implementing controls to maximize life and reduce costs. Drive a strong safety culture, monitor driver safety performance, address unsafe practices, conduct spot checks, and participate in incident investigations. Maintain close coordination with customers, resolve operational issues, improve service satisfaction, and increase revenues through truck utilization. Collaborate with the Maintenance team to improve fleet availability and reliability, reduce costs, and ensure corrective actions for recurring issues. Identify and implement initiatives for operational efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness, establishing KPIs and reviewing processes for continuous improvement. Take overall responsibility for RT Operations at the assigned location, including planning, execution, performance monitoring, reporting, and stakeholder alignment. Operational Management This role involves comprehensive management of daily road transport operations, ensuring proper planning, control, and execution. The manager will monitor operational performance, take timely corrective actions, and ensure alignment across operations, drivers, maintenance, customers, and management. Responsibilities also include preparing daily, weekly, and monthly reports for stakeholders and participating in customer engagements and business process reviews. Work Environment The Divisional Operations Manager will work in a full-time capacity, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires close coordination with various internal teams and external customers to ensure seamless and efficient road transport operations. Application Process Candidates interested in this position are encouraged to apply.

dba8370b24cddb5e.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Construction Manager - Package 1 for a full-time position. This role involves leading all construction-related activities, providing leadership to multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring contractors deliver work safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards on a world-class mega-project. Role Context This position offers the opportunity to work within a dynamic international environment alongside major industry stakeholders on a landmark petrochemical megaproject. It is suited for a seasoned construction professional who thrives in large-scale project environments and is focused on delivering complex industrial facilities safely, efficiently, and successfully. Key Responsibilities Lead, coordinate, and manage all construction activities across Package 1. Promote and strengthen a strong HSE culture, ensuring safety remains the top priority on site. Develop construction strategies, execution plans, and site management procedures. Drive schedule performance by identifying risks, delays, and optimization opportunities. Review and approve construction methodologies, work plans, construction sequences, and execution strategies. Oversee contractors' construction engineering, field planning, coordination, and execution activities. Ensure effective management of testing and pre-commissioning activities. Coordinate closely with engineering, commissioning, operations, and project management teams to ensure a smooth transition to operations. Manage site interfaces, change management processes, and construction-related contractual matters. Monitor project performance in terms of safety, quality, cost, and schedule. Facilitate constructability reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure complete and accurate project documentation, including final handover and As-Built dossiers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management. Demonstrated experience in large-scale project environments and complex construction operations. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage contractors effectively. dbcac46af3ed221d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز مدد للرعاية النهارية عن أخصائي نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقه في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على فهم وتحليل الأنشطة النفسية البشرية، وتحديد القوانين والمبادئ التي تفسر السلوك الفردي في تفاعله مع المحفزات المحيطة. كما يشمل إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة في مجال علم النفس. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة جميع مظاهر الحياة النفسية من خلال تحليل جوانب السلوك المختلفة مثل السلوك الحركي، العقلي، الانفعالي، والاجتماعي. فهم مبادئ التعلم وتطبيقها على حالات التعلم الإنساني وأشكاله المتعددة. إجراء دراسات ميدانية لتطبيق اختبارات الذكاء والأداء بهدف قياس أنماط النمو العقلي والنفسي. دراسة المبادئ والقوانين العامة لاستخلاص الأسس المميزة للسلوك الإنساني. تحليل وتطوير الاتجاهات والقيم الاجتماعية بناءً على المعلومات المستنبطة من المراقبة والمتابعة أو البحوث والتجارب الميدانية. دراسة وتطوير النظريات والاستخدامات التطبيقية في مجال تعديل السلوك. دراسة الأسس البيولوجية للسلوك من خلال التعرف على أجزاء الجهاز العصبي وأثرها في السلوك. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بعلم النفس، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء البحوث وتحليل البيانات النفسية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الأخصائي النفسي ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز مدد للرعاية النهارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق مركز مدد للرعاية النهارية.

dbede3d9d4054e67.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز باستخدام الأجهزة المتخصصة، وتوثيق النتائج، ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وتعليمات الإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل تلتزم بمعايير السلامة والجودة. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة حسب الحاجة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

db10d36e303948d8.description: The Cybersecurity GRC Specialist will support cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance activities across the Group. The role will focus on maintaining cybersecurity policies and controls, coordinating risk assessments and compliance evidence, tracking remediation actions, and supporting regulatory, audit, and assurance activities. Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in cybersecurity GRC, information security, risk, compliance, or a related function. Good understanding of cybersecurity governance, risk assessment, control testing, and compliance. Familiarity with Saudi cybersecurity requirements and information security frameworks. Strong documentation, analytical, and stakeholder coordination skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Professional proficiency in Arabic and English . Certifications such as ISO 27001, CRISC, CISA, CGRC , or equivalent are preferred. Key Responsibilities Support the development and maintenance of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and governance records. Coordinate cybersecurity risk assessments for systems, projects, suppliers, and business initiatives. Maintain risk registers, track treatment plans, and follow up on overdue actions. Support cybersecurity compliance assessments against regulatory and internal requirements. Coordinate the collection, validation, and organization of compliance and audit evidence. Support Internal Audit, external assessments, and regulatory reviews by preparing required cybersecurity evidence. Track audit findings, remediation actions, and closure evidence. Support cybersecurity due diligence and risk reviews for third parties and service providers. Maintain security exceptions, risk acceptance records, and required follow-ups. Prepare GRC reports, dashboards, and management updates. Identify control gaps and opportunities to improve cybersecurity governance processes.

dbc4bfa400a129ef.description: About Egis Egis is an international firm specializing in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, and mobility services. The company focuses on creating and operating intelligent infrastructures and buildings that address climate challenges and contribute to sustainable territorial development. Operating in 77 countries with 23,500 employees, Egis delivers expertise and innovative solutions globally. In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across 8 countries, having completed over 700 development projects. Recognized among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development and serves as a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers through its comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services. The Role of Environmental Specialist Egis is seeking an Environmental Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This permanent contract position involves analyzing environmental aspects of infrastructure projects and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The specialist will play a key role in preparing documentation for environmental permits and providing technical support to design teams. Key Responsibilities Analyze environmental aspects related to infrastructure projects under development. Participate in preparing documentation for environmental permits, approvals, and authorizations. Contribute to the development of project presentation reports, technical documentation for environmental permitting, specialized environmental studies, and environmental sections of technical design documentation. Identify potential environmental impacts and propose prevention, mitigation, or compensation measures. Assess technical solutions from an environmental protection perspective. Provide technical support to design teams regarding applicable environmental requirements. Conduct site visits and field surveys to collect information for environmental documentation. Cooperate with environmental experts, consultants, and competent authorities. Monitor compliance with conditions established by permits and regulatory documents. Prepare documentation for submission to relevant authorities. Participate in meetings and technical sessions with clients and permitting authorities. Respond to requests for clarifications and additional information from authorities. Follow up on the status of environmental permits and approvals. Monitor legislative changes in environmental protection. Inform management and project teams about applicable legal requirements and obligations. Propose compliance measures and internal process improvements. Prepare technical reports and activity updates for assigned projects. Ensure proper recording, filing, and archiving of environmental documentation. Provide information, data, and technical input to management and clients. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in environmental management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to analyze environmental aspects of infrastructure projects. Experience in preparing documentation for environmental permits and regulatory compliance. Strong understanding of environmental protection legislation and requirements. Work Type This is a Permanent Contract position based in Riyadh.

db23217032d3aebc.description: About the Role Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Laser Technician to provide essential support for laser procedures. This full-time role involves assisting with administrative tasks and utilizing comprehensive laser skills to ensure patient satisfaction. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Adhere to all HMG policies, including obtaining an invoice before any procedure. Refer new patients to a Dermatologist for explanation and consent. Refer patients to a Dermatologist for any issues encountered during or after treatment. Communicate politely, accurately, and in a timely manner. Respect patient decisions and ensure patient privacy before and after treatment. Provide health instructions regarding pre- and post-treatment care. Monitor and report any machine or accessory damages or problems to the Charge Nurse (CN), Head Nurse (HN), and Bio-Medical engineers. Maintain confidentiality of all patient treatment information and records. Book clients/patients for their next appointments. Manage the aftercare of all used items. Complete all documentation accurately and clearly after treatment, including parameters used. Orient and assist new staff members within the unit. Identify limitations of new staff and contribute to their skill development. Provide patient and family education as needed. Participate in person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enhance patient experience with compassion, respect, and dignity. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of work. db42c720169a0a43.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الشامل للصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة الفريق وتوزيع المهام. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير مهارات الفريق. معرفة قوية ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وإجراءات تنفيذها. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة في بيئة ديناميكية ضمن مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام الإشراف والتخطيط. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

db9327963ea3b98f.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية is seeking a Director- Food and Beverages to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves overseeing all food and beverage operations across multiple hotels within a portfolio. The Director will combine strategic leadership, commercial acumen, operational expertise, and pre-opening experience to ensure each property delivers a distinctive and competitive food and beverage offering aligned with its market positioning, target guests, and business objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute cluster-wide food and beverage strategies aligned with each hotel's positioning and business objectives. Drive food and beverage revenue, profitability, market share, and guest satisfaction across all properties. Lead all food and beverage pre-opening activities, including concept development reviews and validation of operating models. Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of food and beverage leadership teams prior to opening. Participate in project handovers from development and construction teams to hotel operations. Oversee all restaurants, bars, lounges, cafes, banqueting facilities, and in-room dining across the portfolio. Develop and manage food and beverage budgets across the cluster, monitoring profitability and operating expenses. Build and develop high-performing food and beverage leadership teams and create succession planning programs. Act as the primary food and beverage representative for ownership, consultants, and project teams. This includes validating operating assumptions, managing pre-opening activities, and ensuring successful opening and stabilization of hotels. Responsibilities extend to reviewing and validating Operating Supplies & Equipment (OS&E) requirements, procurement plans, and opening inventories, as well as supporting the preparation and management of Food & Beverage Pre-Opening Budgets (POB). Financial and Talent Management This position is responsible for developing annual business plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance targets for food and beverage operations. It includes reviewing financial performance, implementing corrective actions, and identifying new business opportunities and operating efficiencies. The Director will also focus on talent development, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation, and ensuring optimal staffing structures and employee engagement. Preferred Experience Multi-property or cluster leadership experience. Experience with mixed-positioning hotel portfolios (select-service, midscale, upscale, lifestyle, serviced apartments, family entertainment destinations, or resorts). Experience preparing F&B operating budgets, Pre-Opening Budgets (POB), and staffing models. Experience with banqueting, event operations, and destination food and beverage concepts. Experience supporting hotel openings and stabilization programs across multiple properties. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. The role requires close collaboration with ownership, consultants, and hotel leadership teams to drive revenue growth, profitability, guest satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term asset value.
